evidence.title: Fine-tuned support tone model
evidence.snippet:
# Fine-tuned support tone model

**Client:** a e-commerce company (synthetic).

## Problem
The client needed adapting a language model to our own tone and data and had no in-house capacity.

## What I did
I built the solution with LLM fine-tuning, PyTorch, experiment tracking. The work also involved scripting and automation.

## Result
The project lifted agent acceptance of drafts from 41% to 73%.
